subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

Ritesh remarked, "__Honesty__ is a great virtue."
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Honesty"** means the quality of being truthful and morally upright. (ईमानदारी)

 
 
• **Example: **Honesty is important in building trust in relationships.
 
 
 
• **"Wickedness"** refers to the quality of being evil or morally wrong. (दुष्टता)
 
 
• **Example: **The villain in the story was known for his wickedness.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Honesty'** is **'Wickedness'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Probity** (सत्यनिष्ठा): The quality of having strong moral principles; honesty and decency.

 
 
• **Example:** His reputation for probity was well known in the community.
 
 
 
• **Rectitude** (नैतिकता): Morally correct behavior or thinking.
 
 
• **Example: **He is admired for his rectitude and dedication to justice.
 
 
 
• **Integrity** (अखंडता): The quality of being honest and having strong moral principles.
 
 
• **Example:** She is known for her integrity and fairness.
